name: Alphabet Inc.
notes: Shell parent. Should never match an affiliation string directly — exists only so children roll up. If it ever appears in orgs_unmatched, something is wrong upstream.

name: Google DeepMind
notes: Post-merger entity. valid_from is the April 2023 Brain+DeepMind merger announcement. Do NOT let this absorb pre-2023 strings.

name: DeepMind
notes: Pre-merger. Time-bounded so a 2022 DeepMind paper and a 2024 Google DeepMind paper are the same lineage, not a mobility event.

name: Google Brain
aliases: Google Brain|Brain Team|Google Brain Team|Google Research Brain Team
notes: Pre-merger. Same reasoning as deepmind. Merger will otherwise fire hundreds of false transitions.

name: Google Research
notes: Sibling of DeepMind, not parent and not child. Bare 'Google' is ambiguous — route it here and accept the noise, or leave unmatched. Decide once, document it.

name: Meta Platforms
notes: Facebook renamed to Meta Oct 2021. Window starts 2022 so most strings say Meta, but 2022 stragglers still say Facebook. Alias, not a separate org.

name: FAIR (Fundamental AI Research), Meta
aliases: FAIR|Facebook AI Research|Meta AI|Meta AI Research|FAIR at Meta
notes: Rolls up to meta for scoring. Kept separate because FAIR and GenAI publish very differently — you want to see that in diagnostics even if the score aggregates.

name: Meta Superintelligence Labs
notes: VERIFY the valid_from date against actual paper affiliations before trusting it. Reorg naming lags publications badly.

name: Microsoft Research
aliases: Microsoft Research|MSR|Microsoft Research Redmond|Microsoft Research Cambridge|Microsoft
notes: Multi-site rollup. Bare 'Microsoft' routed here.

name: Microsoft Research Asia
aliases: Microsoft Research Asia|MSRA|Microsoft Research Asia Beijing
notes: Deliberately separate from MSR. High volume — it will dominate Microsoft's rollup. That is a finding to report, not an error to suppress. Country column lets you decompose.

name: Microsoft Corporation
notes: Shell parent, same role as alphabet.

name: OpenAI
notes: Clean case. Few aliases. Low publication volume relative to headcount — the visibility limitation in concentrated form.

name: Anthropic
notes: Clean case. Same visibility caveat as OpenAI.

name: Stanford University
aliases: Stanford University|Stanford|SAIL|Stanford AI Lab|Stanford Artificial Intelligence Laboratory|HAI|Stanford HAI|CRFM|Center for Research on Foundation Models
notes: Named labs roll up to the university. ROR does not map departments, so do not try. One row per institution.

name: University of California Berkeley
aliases: UC Berkeley|University of California Berkeley|Berkeley|BAIR|Berkeley AI Research
notes: Same pattern as stanford.

name: DAMO Academy Alibaba
notes: Non-English alias included deliberately — raw affiliation strings are not always romanised. Corporate research arm rolls up to alibaba.

name: ByteDance Seed
notes: VERIFY the AI Lab to Seed rename date before adding valid_from. Bare 'Seed' is dangerously generic — consider dropping that alias.

name: Allen Institute for AI
aliases: Allen Institute for AI|AI2|Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence|AllenAI
notes: Nonprofit type matters — it is neither academic nor industry for mobility classification. Decide which bucket it joins and be consistent.

name: Alibaba Group
notes: Parent company for Alibaba research labs

name: ByteDance
notes: Parent company for ByteDance research labs
